Three switches outside a room each control one of three bulbs inside. You may flip the switches as much as you like, but may enter the room only once. How do you determine which switch controls which bulb?
choices: Flip each switch on and off in sequence — the order they flicker tells you which is which.
It's impossible with only one entry to the room.
Turn on all three switches at once, then enter — whichever bulb is brightest is switch 1.
Turn on switch 1, wait a few minutes, turn it off, turn on switch 2, then enter — the lit bulb is switch 2, the warm-but-off bulb is switch 1, and the cold, off bulb is switch 3.
